windowsEntry: On Windows, .cmd/.ps1 entry points must be replaced with the native executable or node + CLI.js.
tokenEmpty: The admin token file is empty: {path}
tokenUnreadable: Can't read the admin token: {path} ({strerror}). Use the --home folder you start with.
newToken: Generate a new token if this folder has never been started
extra: Enable an optional Core dependency group, such as --extra learn; repeatable
portBusyShort: Port {port} is already in use; a ShiritaiBot instance may already be running. Close the old instance first, or start on another port: shiritaibot run --port {value}
checkingDeps: Checking Core and plugin dependencies. Preparing the runtime environment the first time can take a few minutes…
portBusy:
Port {port} is already in use; a ShiritaiBot instance may already be running.
· Open http://127.0.0.1:{port2} to see whether it's that one.
· To stop the old instance, close the window running it or end the matching python/shiritaibot process.
· Or start on another port: shiritaibot run --port {value}
logLevel: Bot log level for this run: debug / info / warning / error. Defaults to the level saved in the WebUI.
allowedHost: Extra allowed Host (tunnel or reverse proxy domain); repeatable; supports *.example.com
